comment: Every thing that has a drawing (a recipe in src/scenes/things; a test checks the two agree). `things` are offered as pictures to choose between once their clip exists: only ones a five-year-old would call by exactly that word at a glance. `held` are drawn but not offered: the drawing is fine, but the word is not the child's word for it (a cot is a crib, a tin is a can, a cod is a fish) or the thing itself is not well known (a spinning top).
